The Invitation

To the Woman
Who Lost Herself.

Somewhere along the way, you stopped being yourself. Not overnight — layer by layer. A role you had to play. A person you had to help. An expectation you had to meet.

Maybe you're a mother or a partner holding everything together. Maybe you work in a helping profession, giving yourself to clients, patients, students, teams — day after day, until by evening there's simply nothing left for your own wants. Maybe you can no longer say, clearly, what you want — because you learned long ago to want only what leads somewhere, what achieves something, what counts as "more."

Different paths. The same exhaustion. Every role added a mask. Every mask took a little of the real you.

Becoming Her is not about becoming better. It's about taking off everything that isn't yours, and seeing who's left when the masks come down.

Five nights. A boutique retreat house near Lisbon — land, silence, a space with no roles to play.

Who This Is For

For the Woman
Who Holds Everything Together.

01
For those who carry the family, the home, the everyday logistics — and have long forgotten what it feels like to be held themselves.
02
For women in the helping professions — therapists, doctors, coaches, teachers — who give themselves away all day, every day, and keep nothing in reserve for themselves.
03
For anyone who has felt, for a while now, that something isn't right. Who has lost touch with her own wants, and can't quite remember how to want something simply — not for an achievement, not for anyone else's benefit.
The Practices

Eight Ways
Back to Yourself.

I
Space to Rest
The first gift is permission to stop. Perhaps for the first time in a long while, your nervous system can stand down. There is nothing to prove here.
II
Body Practices
The body remembers what the mind gave up long ago, for the sake of politeness. We release the muscular armor, the social filters — and return the sensitivity that was always yours.
III
Lila — The Game of the Soul's Path
An ancient map-game that mirrors your inner landscape — illusions, attachments, breakthroughs. Every move is not chance; it's a meeting with exactly what needs your attention right now.
IV
Fire Ceremony
A conscious burning of old identities and contracts that no longer serve your soul. Fire doesn't ask permission — it simply releases.
V
Chanting & Kirtan
The voice you've held back for years returns through shared sound. This isn't a performance — it's a breakthrough of the barrier that kept your heart closed.
VI
Creative Regeneration
Making anchor jewelry — physical witnesses to who you're becoming. Something you can wear, and remember by.
VII
Partner Therapeutic Practices
A vulnerability that's hard to find alone. You learn to see yourself through another woman's eyes — and, perhaps for the first time in a long while, feel truly seen.
VIII
Gift Artifacts
Symbolic objects to help carry this experience into ordinary life — for when the retreat ends, and the transformation doesn't.
Your Guide

Held by Someone
Who Has Been There.

Founder of Neo Healing · Somatic Practitioner · Retreat Facilitator

When did you last feel like yourself — without a role, without a function, without "should"?

Anastasiia works at the intersection of somatic therapy, breathwork, ceremony, and the nervous system's own language — the Neo Healing method she built from her own long road back to herself.

She couldn't answer the question above honestly for a long time either. When she finally did, Becoming Her was born — not as a productivity course, not as one more tool to help you get more done, but as a space where you can stop keeping up. Stop holding your face together. Stop being convenient for everyone except yourself.

On this retreat, she holds space the way she wishes someone had held it for her — without fixing, without rushing, without asking you to perform wellness. She is not a therapist standing outside the process. She's a woman walking the same road, a little further ahead, guiding without pretending she has arrived either.

A Personal Note

From Anastasiia.

Hi.

I don't know at what point in your journey you're reading these lines. Maybe after another day where you managed everything, for everyone. Maybe after a shift where you gave others your attention, your care, your professional support all day — and by evening realized there was nothing left for yourself. Or maybe you've simply felt, for a while now, that something isn't right. That you're moving, achieving, performing — and can no longer recall a want of your own that isn't tied to "should" or "right."

I want to ask you one thing. When did you last feel like yourself — without a role, without a function, without "should"?

I couldn't answer that honestly myself for a long time. And when I finally did — Becoming Her was born.

This isn't a course on productivity. It isn't one more tool to help you get more done. It's the opposite — a space where you can stop keeping up. Stop holding your face together. Stop being convenient for everyone except yourself.

Five nights near Lisbon. Earth, fire, body, voice — and women who are also finding their way back to themselves.

I won't promise you a magical transformation in five days. I promise you an honest space, where there's a real chance to remember.

If your heart has already responded, but the finances haven't — write to me. We'll find a way, together.

With love,
your guide
